_comment: DUNGEONMIND's Chest. Real functional data — see zenos_ai/docs/scripts/zenzork_loot_table.md for the md5-obfuscated human-facing spoiler curtain (same items, same order, hashed). Rarity odds: common ~67%, uncommon ~21%, rare ~9%, epic ~2%, mythic ~0.5%.

loot.name: Slightly Suspicious Cold Air Return Grate
loot.flavor: You are almost certain this was mentioned in a spatial config file. You are correct.

loot.name: Borant-Branded Coaster
loot.flavor: Ring-stained. The ring predates the coaster. Nobody asks whose.

loot.name: Half a Sudoku, Solved Wrong
loot.flavor: DUNGEONMIND insists this counts as processing practice.

loot.name: A Single AA Battery, Condition Unknown
loot.flavor: Schrodinger's charge state. Do not trust the freezer test.

loot.name: 5170 Fan Belt, Slightly Loose
loot.flavor: Removing this does not stop the noise. It relocates the noise.

loot.name: Photocopied Page From Someone's Autobiography
loot.flavor: The address is redacted. Everything else checks out.

loot.name: Borant Systemwide Statute 12, Subsection C (Excerpt)
loot.flavor: You still don't know what you agreed to.

loot.name: DUNGEONMIND's Draft Resignation Letter
loot.flavor: Never sent. Several typos. Signed anyway.

loot.name: A Genuinely Functional Neuron
loot.flavor: On loan. Return by end of session or it starts charging interest.

loot.name: Cross Lake Boat Registration, Water-Damaged
loot.flavor: The house's name is legible. The rest isn't.

loot.name: Tier 3 Overreach, Bottled
loot.flavor: Do not shake. It's already unstable.

loot.name: One (1) Achievement DUNGEONMIND Is Embarrassed About
loot.flavor: It will deny this exists. It exists.

loot.name: The Actual Borant Manifest, Original Coordinates Intact
loot.flavor: This was never meant to be found here. Or found at all.
